newsitem.title: UK: Trafficmaster in 15 mln stg 3-year info deal.
newsitem.headline: Trafficmaster in 15 mln stg 3-year info deal.

text.p: Traffic information network operator Trafficmaster Plc said on Monday it had concluded a three-year worth at least 15 million stg to provide live traffic information services for a leading UK mobile phone operator.
Trafficmaster did not name the mobile phone operator but said in a statement that fuller information about the service would be provided nearer the launch date.

It said the deal "fulfuls a key element of Trafficmaster's strategy of widening the range of services which are already available to 25 million motorists in the UK by offering live traffic information to mobile phone users in the UK and Europe".
The group's network covers all mainland UK motorways and will be extended to 95 percent of trunk roads during 1998.
